Full report National Summary

Federal Reserve Bank of Boston

Summary of Economic Activity
Business activity expanded at a modest pace. Contacts reported elevated uncertainty tied to inflation and the war in Ukraine.

Employment and Wages
Employment rose modestly, but hiring plans were uncertain amid slowing demand. Wage growth stayed strong as workers remained scarce.

Prices
Prices increased sharply. Input costs continued to climb.
